svg.title: Weekly product census: separate units and retention tests

g.text: Weekly products, retention and static use
Bars: produced — blue outside recorded gaps; orange inside gaps; gray after gap cutoff. Lines: green retained; purple use proxy.
UTC ISO weeks; W31 and W39 partial. Independent y-scales and units. Unknown is not zero. No sum across kinds.
See report for exact counting rules, coverage and limitations.
See report for exact counting rules, coverage and limitations.
Retained and imported-line traces are known minima: 2,014 XTDB added lines have unknown survival.
Retained test file = requested testing proxy; no pass receipts were audited.
Use = static membership in explicitly named library targets; not proof of a successful build.
Retention = at least one line in selected current drafts; publication/use is not measured.
Paper · textual additions / retained draft lines
Retention limited to four selected current draft roots and their tracked TeX/bibliography inputs.
See report for exact counting rules, coverage and limitations.
Discarded signal · new files later deleted
See report for exact counting rules, coverage and limitations.
Only the seven report-identified E6b files; no external src imports found. Not a general discard classifier.
